summary.plain: With three years of data, ANAIS-112 again found no yearly modulation, and says its result is incompatible with the DAMA/LIBRA signal at 3.3 standard deviations (2.6 in the other energy range).
summary.technical: Blind analysis of three years (effective exposure 313.95 kg yr): modulation amplitude -0.0034 +- 0.0042 cpd/kg/keV in [1-6] keV and 0.0003 +- 0.0037 cpd/kg/keV in [2-6] keV; incompatible with DAMA/LIBRA at 3.3 (2.6) sigma for a sensitivity of 2.5 (2.7) sigma; also a phase-free search and a search for periodic signals at other frequencies.

title: Annual modulation results from three-year exposure of ANAIS-112
why_it_matters: The first ANAIS-112 result to state a statistical (in)compatibility with the DAMA/LIBRA modulation, with the same target material.
